text.en: Grenades fired from this weapon attach on impact and detonate when enemies are in proximity.
Grenades fired from this weapon attach on impact and detonate when enemies are in proximity.

Grenades stick to impacted surfaces for up to ? seconds and detonate once an enemy gets within ? meters.

Increases Destonation damage by 30% and decreases Impact damage by 85%.

Due to the ratio of Detonation and Impact damage being tied to the Blast Radius stat on Grenade Launchers, a higher stat will be more beneficial:
• 20 Blast Radius: 6% decreased total damage
• 100 Blast Radius: 11% increased total damage
